targets.rawSql: SELECT '${animation:raw}' AS "Animation",'${topology_level:raw}' AS "Topology Level",'site' AS "Mode",a.site_key AS "Site Key",a.site_name AS "Data Center",a.upstream_core_01 AS "Core Switch A",a.upstream_core_02 AS "Core Switch B",a.switch_name AS "Access Switch",a.switch_interface AS "Switch Interface",a.server_key AS "Server Key",a.server_name AS "Server",so.status AS "Server Status",so.health_status AS "Server Health",so.available AS "Server Available",so.open_alerts AS "Server Alerts",a.rack_key AS "Rack Key",a.rack_name AS "Rack Name",a.server_interface AS "Server Interface",initcap(a.redundancy_role) AS "Redundancy Role",a.vlan_id::text AS "VLAN",a.vlan_name AS "VLAN Name",a.vrf_name AS "VRF",a.cidr::text AS "Subnet",a.server_ip_addresses::text AS "Server IP",round(coalesce(ni.speed_bps,0)/1000000000.0,0)::text||' Gbps' AS "Switch Speed",initcap(coalesce(ni.attributes->>'operational_status',ni.administrative_status,a.connection_status)) AS "Port Status",round(coalesce((ni.attributes->>'rx_utilization_pct')::numeric,0),1) AS "RX %",round(coalesce((ni.attributes->>'tx_utilization_pct')::numeric,0),1) AS "TX %",coalesce((ni.attributes->>'errors')::integer,0) AS "Port Errors",initcap(a.connection_status) AS "Status",s.servers AS "Servers",s.virtual_machines AS "VMs",s.k8s_clusters AS "K8s Clusters",s.k8s_nodes AS "K8s Nodes",s.k8s_pods AS "Pods",s.applications AS "Applications" FROM inventory.server_network_attachment_overview a JOIN inventory.site_full_stack_topology_overview s ON s.site_key=a.site_key JOIN inventory.server_operational_overview so ON so.server_key=a.server_key LEFT JOIN inventory.network_devices nd ON nd.device_key=a.switch_key LEFT JOIN inventory.network_interfaces ni ON ni.network_device_id=nd.id AND ni.interface_name=a.switch_interface WHERE a.site_key='${site:raw}' AND ('${topology_level:raw}'='Rack Connectivity' OR '${rack:raw}'='All' OR a.rack_key='${rack:raw}') ORDER BY a.rack_key,a.switch_name,a.switch_interface,a.server_key

SELECT r.name AS "Rack",r.rack_key AS "Rack Key",coalesce(sw.l2_switches,0) AS "L2 Switches",coalesce(ss.servers,0) AS "Servers",coalesce(ss.up_servers,0) AS "Up",coalesce(ss.warning_servers,0) AS "Maintenance / Warning",coalesce(ss.down_servers,0) AS "Down",coalesce(vs.vms,0) AS "VMs",coalesce(ks.k8s_nodes,0) AS "K8s Nodes",coalesce(ks.pods,0) AS "Pods",round(100.0*coalesce(ss.up_servers,0)/nullif(ss.servers,0),1) AS "Server Health %" FROM inventory.racks r JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) l2_switches FROM inventory.network_devices nd WHERE nd.rack_id=r.id AND nd.device_type='switch' AND nd.role ILIKE '%access%') sw ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) servers,count(*) FILTER (WHERE sv.status='active' AND sv.health_status='healthy') up_servers,count(*) FILTER (WHERE sv.status='maintenance' OR sv.health_status IN ('warning','degraded')) warning_servers,count(*) FILTER (WHERE sv.status='failed' OR sv.health_status='critical') down_servers FROM inventory.servers sv WHERE sv.rack_id=r.id) ss ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) vms FROM inventory.virtual_machines vm JOIN inventory.hypervisors h ON h.id=vm.hypervisor_id JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=h.server_id WHERE sv.rack_id=r.id) vs ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(DISTINCT kn.id) k8s_nodes,count(DISTINCT p.id) pods FROM inventory.k8s_nodes kn LEFT JOIN inventory.virtual_machines vm ON vm.id=kn.vm_id LEFT JOIN inventory.hypervisors h ON h.id=vm.hypervisor_id LEFT JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=coalesce(kn.server_id,h.server_id) LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_pods p ON p.node_id=kn.id WHERE sv.rack_id=r.id) ks ON true WHERE s.site_key='${site:raw}' AND ('${rack:raw}'='All' OR r.rack_key='${rack:raw}') ORDER BY r.rack_key
